title: Healthcare provider
description: SMART Base's generic persona DAK.Persona.HealthcareProvider: a member of the health workforce who delivers health interventions (the PHC handbook's 'health worker'). It takes on the health-worker role in the point-of-care processes. Its description is the ActorDefinition's; nothing is restated here.

reference: who-iris library 9789240093362-eng (Digital transformation handbook for primary health care), sec-002-glossary (health workers as end-users of a PCPOSS)
who-iris library 9789240093362-eng sec-013-32-get-to-know-the-users (a persona per health worker occupational group)
